name: Build a prospect list, rank it and send first messages
why: A ready workflow from ideal customer to a ranked list and checked first messages, matching the outbound campaign workflow.

name: Cold outreach batch runner
why: Runs cold email in checked batches and learns from the last batch's results, like the weekly review step.

name: Cold call script writer
why: A quick cold call script with opener, questions, brush-off replies and voicemail, a lighter version of the call script skill.

name: Cold email claim checker
why: Tests every claim in a cold email against the prospect's own page before it goes out.

name: Follow-up email sequence writer
why: Turns one email into follow-ups with a new reason each time and a stop rule, the same rule this kit uses.

name: Lead grader
why: Grades prospects A, B or C by how soon they need to act, a fast first pass before full scoring.

name: Prospecting block planner
why: Protects a daily call block with quick research and one reason to call each lead.

name: Sales call prep assistant
why: Builds a one-page call plan from past notes, a close cousin of the account research brief.

name: Prepare an enterprise account plan
why: Maps buyer roles and deal risks for a large account once a meeting turns into a real opportunity.

name: Objection answer sheet writer
why: Builds an answer sheet for buyer doubts, useful alongside the reply and brush-off scripts.

name: Offer useful information first and follow up with stalled leads
why: For C-tier and quiet leads: an information offer and follow-ups instead of more cold touches.
